comments.body: I like how this review turns the usual attention story around. Instead of asking only which representation gets boosted, Foxe and Snyder make a strong case that the ignored channel may need its own active control signal, with alpha rising where distracting input would otherwise compete.

score_assessment.rationale: Accurately captures the review's central suppression argument and frames it clearly without overclaiming.

comments.body: The bilateral rapid-stream example seems especially important because it pushes against the old cortical-idling explanation. If both visual streams are still being stimulated and alpha climbs above the pre-cue baseline for the ignored side, that looks much more like active filtering than simple recovery after stimulation.

score_assessment.rationale: Uses a specific evidential test from the source and explains its relevance to the active-suppression claim.

comments.body: One thing I would keep in view is that this is a review article, so the force of the argument depends on how consistently the cited paradigms line up. The cross-modal pattern is compelling, but it is still a synthesis rather than one unified experiment testing the whole mechanism at once.

score_assessment.rationale: Adds a useful scope caveat grounded in the source's review status while acknowledging the convergent evidence.

comments.body: The retinotopic angle makes the claim feel more concrete to me. Alpha increasing over cortex that corresponds to the ignored hemifield is a cleaner prediction than a vague statement that attention changes oscillations somewhere in the back of the head.

score_assessment.rationale: Highlights anatomical specificity in the spatial attention evidence with a clear, source-consistent interpretation.

comments.body: I also appreciated that the authors do not treat all alpha as one thing. Separating attention-related alpha from arousal-related alpha makes the model less tidy, but it is probably necessary if frontal-parietal control and thalamic contributions are doing different jobs.

score_assessment.rationale: Engages the mechanism limits section thoughtfully and avoids overstating unresolved circuitry.
